Episode 128: Zephyrin (1)
Blood gushed out from the Black Knight's hood. The poison on the nails was so intense that the wound on the side, where the nails struck, had already turned black.

Although taken off guard, the Black Knight was still a Black Knight. He was one of only ten knights in Runcandel who were allowed to wear the black helmet, and even with a severe injury, he managed to counterattack immediately.
However, the claw that protruded from the robe's sleeve did not reach Zephyrin. The blade aimed for the neck, but it left only a trace in the air.
Swoosh! Zephyrin's nails and the Black Knight's claw collided once more.
The highly poisoned body was not as usual. The Black Knight took a step back after just one exchange and spat out blood again as he widened the distance.
If the Black Knight had been alone, the battle would have been decided at that moment. Already fatally injured, the Black Knight had no chance to withstand Zephyrin's subsequent fierce attacks.
Jin, Murakan, and Balkas stepped forward simultaneously.
'What is this...?'
Their reactions were surprisingly fast, but all three had shocked and strained faces.
For Jin, the fact that the 'Black Knight' was struck in one blow was shocking.
'Even if he was off guard, it's impossible unless he has the power of Yona or the Nameless King, or even surpasses the Black Knight.'
Ability and power. Zephyrin could possess either one or both.
One thing was certain: she was an extremely challenging enemy for the group to handle.
"Oh my, the Runcandel Black Knights are indeed amazing. I didn't expect them to dodge this."
The Black Knight could only lick his already blue lips and couldn't respond.
He didn't have the leisure to answer while suppressing the extreme poison spreading throughout his body.
"Zephyrin, you! Don't tell me you took out the deputy leader...!"
The original plan was for the deputy leader to bring the Black Knight.
Balkas couldn't help but worry about his subordinates, including the deputy leader.
If Zephyrin had shown her power just now, it would have been entirely possible for her to assassinate them and come looking. Balkas worried, judging from this possibility.
When Balkas glared at her with a murderous gaze, Zephyrin flashed a bright smile.

"I told you, you don't need to know. The leader is going to die. I wanted to send you off peacefully because of our past bond, but if you keep asking pointless questions, I might have to kill you painfully."
At that, Murakan chuckled.
"Quikantel was right about you. Hey, hey. You little demon dragon, I wanted to ask you anyway, but thanks for revealing your identity first."
Whoosh...!
As Murakan transformed into his true form, a dense aura spread throughout the spacious reception room.
[It's obvious why you're doing this now. It must be because of that demon from Lontelgious… Yeah, you must have enough confidence to attack even knowing I, Murakan, am here, right?]
In the past, before the demon society disappeared from power, Murakan had fought numerous demon dragons who betrayed their kin.

And he had never been defeated. He had always achieved overwhelming victories against the powerful devil dragons, and at some point, even the top devil dragons of the four major noble families at that time avoided any encounter with Murakan.
Murakan's fame was not only in the human world but also in the demon society. His name was known as the ruler of the sky.
However, there was no one using the name 'Zephyrin' among the powerful devil dragons Murakan knew.
'Is it because of a problem with my memory, or is it someone I've never encountered before? Hmmm, I think I've beaten most of the famous devil dragons at least once. Where did this guy come from?'
He couldn't judge quickly.
Zephyrin, who slowly turned his head and looked at Jin and Murakan, said:
"Haha, you're still as arrogant as ever, Lord Murakan."
[You seem to know me, but I don't remember seeing someone like you.]
"Memory... That's possible. Is there any dragon in the world who doesn't know you? The only dragon that could rule the blue and beautiful sky of the human world was you."
[That's why my attitude is not arrogance but truth. Reveal your true identity.]

"I won't kill you unlike the commander. Instead, you'll fall into a deep sleep with a broken heart once again. When you wake up, you'll have to face a world different from the one you knew. Just like this time."
Jiiiiit-!
A purple energy suddenly spread from Zephyrin's hand.
'Magic? No, it's different. It feels similar to when the dead Rontelgius' demon used an unknown magic, but it's much deeper and darker.'
Jin thought as he reacted to the spreading purple energy.
What Zephyrin unfolded was not magic, but magic energy. A scale so large that even Murakan would be taken aback.
The magic energy enveloped the entire reception room in an instant, and Jin could intuitively sense that it was forming some kind of 'subspace'.
As the magic energy spread, Jin and Balkas rushed towards Zephyrin.
In the purple darkness, Sigmund's pale blade and thunderbolt flashed, and the heavy aura surrounding Balkas' fist trembled.
Balkas, in addition to the name of the third-ranked mercenary, was also classified as one of the world's best 'fighters'.
Zheung-!
Zephyrin swung the axe-sword on his back to block Balkas' thrown fist.

As soon as the fist and axe-sword made contact, a shockwave spread, and if the magic energy hadn't been eroding the space, most of the interior of the reception room would have been shattered by the impact.
The subspace covered in magic energy looked like a completely different empty space rather than a reception room.
At that moment, Jin pushed his blade into Zephyrin's side, but Zephyrin bent the axe-sword to block it easily.
Both Jin and Balkas felt an enormous shock passing through their wrists.
Zephyrin's seemingly lightly swung axe-sword caused the blessed bodies of Runecandale and the steel bodies of the 10-star warriors to suffer from pain and shock.
Aaaah!

As soon as the two stepped back after their attack, Murakan unleashed a dark breath attack. It was a breath that could potentially destroy a small castle in one shot, but Zephyrin effortlessly deflected it.
He wore a face full of laughter.
"Your breath is as warm as I've heard, Lord Murakan."
Murakan didn't reply, but formed blades of energy on his wings and shot them out.
Jin and Balkas moved between the blades as if performing acrobatics, attacking Zephyrin from time to time.
Watching the skillful movements of the axe-sword, it felt like watching Luna.
Even while defending against the attacks of Jin, Balkas, and Murakan, Zephyrin maintained his composure.
A formidable opponent among formidable opponents.
Aha, Zephyrin, who laughed and swung his axe-sword, seemed to simply enjoy the situation.
Kwajik! Crackle! Chaaang-!
Two swords, a fist, and energy mixed together, dyeing the dark space chaotically.
The fight seemed like a stalemate at a glance.
'Really, even if it's a stalemate, we're at a disadvantage.'
Behind them, the dying Black Knight was their companion.
Of course, he was Joshua's man, and Joshua had sent him to the Black King's Castle to interfere with Jin. The Black Knight was definitely one of the strongest forces in Runecandle.

Losing the Black Knight so pathetically was a problem that directly affected the power of the family. From a very strict perspective, he was not exactly Joshua's man but the 'next head of the family.'
'We need immediate healing from the King of the Fortress and his healers, or a poison expert on the level of Kujan.'
If it weren't for the 10-star body, death would have been certain the moment he was pricked by a fingernail.
It was such a horrible poison that even Jin, who possessed the Venomous Curse, instinctively felt he couldn't be completely immune.
How long could the Black Knight endure? Judging by his trembling and spewing bloody foam, it didn't seem like he could hold on for long.
They increased their speed. The Black King's commander was also extremely tense, as the death of the Black Knight on his own land could escalate the problem.
[What have you heard? Among the demon dragons that challenged me back then, those who had to face my breath are all gone now.]

"Well, that's true. But I could have been friends with other ordinary dragons, right? Anyway, you might have been arrogant once, but now you're just an old man who can't forget his heyday. It would be better for you to fight properly, like you did at the Sword Emperor Castle."
At that, Murakan burst into laughter again.
[Properly? Back then, I couldn't fight freely because I was protecting humans. I'll send you where you want, to hell.]
"Oh, I'm looking forward to it!"
The sword energy imbued with the magic from the axe-sword slashed and tore wildly in all directions.
Murakan's energy barrier was ripped apart, and Jin and Balkas stepped back hastily, shooting their sword energy.
To anyone watching, it was clearly a powerful and incredible sword energy, but by then...
Jin and his companions realized that Zephyrin's swordsmanship was strangely clumsy.
'The power is certainly fierce, but for some reason, the swordsmanship is unnaturally awkward.'
'It's like moving while wearing clothes that don't fit.'
He was good at blocking and swinging, but the movement of the sword was not smooth.
Of course, this was visible to Jin and Balkas, who were experienced warriors. Any ordinary warrior below the 8-star level wouldn't have been able to notice this feeling at all.
Suddenly, an unpleasant and uneasy feeling crept into their minds.
'Could it be that the axe-sword isn't his main weapon...?'

At first, they didn't notice because they were too busy exchanging attacks, and also because of Zephyrin's extraordinary physical abilities. That Zephyrin was using a very clumsy 'axe-sword technique.'
Their intuition soon turned into certainty, and goosebumps rose on their backs and forearms.
All three of them suppressed their bewildered feelings, but Zephyrin saw right through them.
And as if he finally realized they had figured it out, he shrugged his shoulders and said:
"Well, it seemed interesting, and I was curious, so I tried using it... Is it really that pathetic? Haha."
Just as when he pretended to be human.
Zephyrin had never properly mastered the axe-sword in his life. He was just curious about what the main weapon of one of his protectees would be like.
Voom, whoosh!
Zephyrin playfully swung the axe-sword in the air.
Then, as if his interest had faded, and as if it would be difficult to easily kill them with this, he nonchalantly threw the axe-sword to the ground.
The fallen axe-sword made a heavy noise.
"No matter what, it doesn't seem right to destroy Lord Murakan's heart with something like this. I should at least put you to sleep with some respect."
